name: Magecart payment skimming
summary: Groups inject JavaScript skimmers into checkout pages of e-commerce sites, often through vulnerable or compromised Magento extensions; not a single vulnerability
notes: not a CVE, so no CVSS or KEV status; the page lists attacks on Magento and other platforms (secondary source)

name: CVE-2022-24086 improper input validation in checkout
summary: Unauthenticated remote code execution in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source, patched out of band (APSB22-12)
notes: KEV entry dated before the NVD publication date; CVSS v3.1 base score from NVD; KEV status from the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog (https://www.cisa.gov/known-exploited-vulnerabilities-catalog) checked 2026-10-27

name: CosmicSting (CVE-2024-34102)
summary: Unauthenticated XML external entity injection, chained with a PHP bug to read secrets and gain code execution (APSB24-40)
notes: name CosmicSting coined by Sansec; CVSS v3.1 base score from NVD; KEV status from the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog (https://www.cisa.gov/known-exploited-vulnerabilities-catalog) checked 2026-10-27

name: SessionReaper (CVE-2025-54236)

notes: name SessionReaper coined by Sansec; CVSS v3.1 base score from NVD; KEV status from the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog (https://www.cisa.gov/known-exploited-vulnerabilities-catalog) checked 2026-10-27

name: CVE-2026-75650 template engine injection

notes: out-of-band hotfix; published 2026-09-07; CVSS v3.1 base score from NVD; KEV status from the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog (https://www.cisa.gov/known-exploited-vulnerabilities-catalog) checked 2026-10-27

notes: core vulnerability; CVSS v3.1 base score from NVD; KEV status from the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog (https://www.cisa.gov/known-exploited-vulnerabilities-catalog) checked 2026-10-27

name: July 2021 forced update (CVE-2021-32789)
